# Jasypt Karaf Support

> Provides Jasypt encryption/decryption support as an OSGi bundle for Apache Karaf, registering a default StringEncryptor service and exposing Karaf console commands for cryptographic operations.

Key facts:
- Java 11, single-module Maven project with Maven Wrapper (`./mvnw`)
- OSGi bundle packaged with Felix Maven Bundle Plugin
- Core dependencies: Apache Karaf 4.0.7, Jasypt 1.9.2, OSGi 6.0.0
- Registers a `StringEncryptor` OSGi service (highest priority) used by PAX-JDBC for encrypted database passwords
- Exposes four Karaf shell commands: `jasypt:encrypt`, `jasypt:decrypt`, `jasypt:digest`, `jasypt:info`
- License: Apache 2.0

## Source — Services

- [pom.xml](pom.xml): Maven build configuration with OSGi bundle packaging, CI-friendly versioning, and deployment profiles
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/karaf/jasypt/services/DefaultStringEncryptorConfig.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/karaf/jasypt/services/DefaultStringEncryptorConfig.java): OSGi DS component that creates and registers a StringEncryptor service via ConfigAdmin

## Source — Karaf Commands

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/karaf/jasypt/commands/Encrypt.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/karaf/jasypt/commands/Encrypt.java): `jasypt:encrypt` command for PBE encryption
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/karaf/jasypt/commands/Decrypt.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/karaf/jasypt/commands/Decrypt.java): `jasypt:decrypt` command for PBE decryption
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/karaf/jasypt/commands/Digest.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/karaf/jasypt/commands/Digest.java): `jasypt:digest` command for digest computation and validation
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/karaf/jasypt/commands/Info.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/karaf/jasypt/commands/Info.java): `jasypt:info` command listing available algorithms
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/karaf/jasypt/commands/OutputTypeCompleter.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/karaf/jasypt/commands/OutputTypeCompleter.java): Tab completion for output types (base64, hexadecimal)
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/karaf/jasypt/commands/PBEAlgorithmCompleter.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/karaf/jasypt/commands/PBEAlgorithmCompleter.java): Tab completion for PBE algorithms
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/karaf/jasypt/commands/DigestAlgorithmCompleter.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/karaf/jasypt/commands/DigestAlgorithmCompleter.java): Tab completion for digest algorithms
